conservativeBoundary: Any explicit name or nome field, including an explicit blank, remains opaque to this bounded prefix permission.
Dynamic or unknown owners, uncertain identity, generated-target dependencies, and unsupported argument forms remain opaque.
The prefix establishes a reserved namespace for observers and disjoint-work safety, not permission to synthesize a complete reference identity.
An unchanged supported helper can coexist with disjoint literal-reference repairs only when all generated helper bytes and reference associations remain intact.
A changed Sfn or Sfnp requires the separate fresh author-repair contract, exactly one generated helper, and an exact unique native bibliography binding.
